# Popsy Loves You

> Popsy Loves You is an art series by Brandon Kaufer, also known as Popsy Wolf: handmade ceramic (clay) monsters, each one a feeling we usually push down, like the anxious one, the sad one, or the one that just wants to play. Every monster has a name, a family and a story, and they are all looking for a home.

- Artist: Brandon Kaufer (aka Popsy Wolf)
- Website: https://popsy-neon.vercel.app/
- Family tree: https://popsy-neon.vercel.app/family
- Monsters: 57 (44 available to adopt, 13 adopted)
- Families: Dirtle, Glimmerwick, Roarborn. The family tree starts with Popsy and runs down through the generations.
- Adopting: open any available monster on the site and use Inquire to message Brandon.
- Site design and build: RADCAT (https://radcat.design)

## About, in Brandon's words

My grandpa’s answer to everything, big and small, was “no problem.”

That was the first thing he ever gave me. Friends died when I was young, no problem. My parents split, no problem. A business partner steals all of our money and destroys everything we built for years, no problem. Things kept coming at me and instead of working through any of it, I brushed it off, said I was fine, and kept moving.

Fast forward to 2023, we’re on the other side of COVID, the house I’d put every dollar of savings into was gone, I’d been to more funerals than I could count, and the relationship was over. “No problem” stopped working.

That’s when my therapist told me to get a hobby. So I took a ceramics class.

I made some really shitty mugs and bowls for a while. Then one afternoon something I was working on grew a face, and the face had an expression I recognized, a face of pure panic. WTF is this?? I kept going. Within a few months I had a storage unit full of monsters big and small. Some anxious, some sad, some scared, some that just wanted to play.

They were me. The parts that showed up every time I said “no problem”. And that’s when I realized that they’d been running the place for years. Making decisions for me. Taking my silence for permission. I had never met them, so I couldn’t even argue. But at the studio, I got to meet them, learn their names, understand their stories, and hear where they came from.

I knew the world I wanted to build, a world where we could all meet the gremlins that are running us unconsciously and turn them into friendly monsters that could be a part of our story in a much better way.

It’s starting out with clay, and who knows where we’re headed.

We are all carrying an enormous amount right now, large and small, and nobody handed us any tools. Every incentive we have says push it down, keep moving, stay in the cycle, be fine.

F that.

Face your gremlins. Play with your monsters. Get back to being a kid about it. There’s still plenty of time.

That’s Popsy Wolf. That’s the whole of it.

Brandon Kaufer
aka Popsy Wolf

## The monsters

### Bodie Dirtle "The Good Sport"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Darlene Dirtle.

Bodie throws his arms up for everything. You won? Amazing. He lost? Great game. It rained on the picnic? Free shower. He is so committed to taking things well that he forgets to notice when something actually hurts. He closes his eyes when he smiles, which is either joy or a way of not looking too closely. Everyone wants him on their team. Bodie would like, someday, to be a little bit of a sore loser and see what that feels like.

### Brindle Dirtle "The Holder of Everything"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Stubbs Dirtle.

Brindle has his arms out and something in every hand. Your coat, your keys, your worry, the thing you said you would deal with on Tuesday. He offered once and never stopped. He is steady, sturdy and very good at this, and he would rather drop dead than drop anything. Nobody remembers asking him to carry it all. He does not remember volunteering. Somewhere under the pile is a monster who would love to set one thing down without apologizing for it.

### Craig Dirtle "The Reliable Wildcard"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Adopted. Parent: Siddles Dirtle.

Craig will call you “family” before you even finish your drink the first time you meet him, and somehow, you’ll believe him. Son of Siddles, he inherited that Dirtle gift for connection, but somewhere along the way, it got tangled up with self-preservation. He’s magnetic, steady, and loyal until loyalty gets inconvenient. There’s a certain sparkle in his one eye that makes you feel seen, but also quietly evaluated. When Craig promises he’s got your back, he means it, he’s just also making sure you’re not standing too close to his. Still, for all his guardedness, you can’t stay mad. There’s something about him that makes every betrayal feel like an accident you almost forgive.

### Darlene Dirtle "gimme 5"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Marnie Dirtle.

Darlene loves what she does. She really does. She just did not realize how much of herself it would take to keep doing it this way. She shows up, follows through, holds things together, and makes it look easier than it is, which is part of the problem. Somewhere along the way, being needed became the same thing as being okay, and she has been running on that math ever since. She is not resentful. She is just… tired in a way that does not get fixed by sleep. The truth is, Darlene does not need to care less. She just needs a moment where nothing is asking anything from her. And she might not take it unless someone reminds her she is allowed to.

### Dremmel Dirtle "The Realization In Progress"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Adopted. Parent: Fennick Dirtle.

Dremmel realizes things while they are already happening, which is both helpful and not. He moves through moments like a live commentary track, catching patterns just in time to notice them but not always in time to change them. He was formed in that exact space between reaction and awareness, which is why he is constantly mid-adjustment. It is not that he does not know better. It is that the knowing arrives a few seconds late and insists on being included anyway. The truth is, Dremmel is getting closer. Every time he notices, something shifts, even if it is small. And eventually, those small shifts start happening sooner.

### Fennick Dirtle "The Over-Observer"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Craig Dirtle.

Fennick grew up convinced that if he just watched closely enough, nothing bad could happen. Raised under Craig’s “trust me, kid” brand of chaos, he learned early that paying attention was a survival skill. These days, he’s got an eye on everything, literally. He pops one out to keep tabs on the room, swearing it helps him “stay ahead of disappointment.” Fennick over-explains, over-thinks, and apologizes mid-sentence for things that haven’t gone wrong yet. Still, he’s sweet about it, more endearing than paranoid. Marnie says he inherited all of Craig’s nerves but none of his charm; Orbin just calls him “our family surveillance system.”

### Frillik Dirtle "The Two-Thought Tango"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Peepers Dirtle.

Frillik is never having just one thought, and neither of them can agree on anything. One side scans for what could go wrong while the other rushes to smooth it over before it does, creating a kind of emotional choreography no one asked for. He was formed mid-compromise, somewhere between honesty and likability, and he has been negotiating with himself ever since. Frillik is the monster equivalent of saying “it’s all good” while internally hosting a full debate panel. The thing is, he notices everything. The shift in tone, the unsaid tension, the moment someone feels left out. It is exhausting, but it also means he cares in a way most creatures do not. If you watch closely, you will notice neither of him is leading, but somehow he still makes space for everyone else to feel held.

### Gabbles Dirtle "The Family Megaphone"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Adopted. Parent: Siddles Dirtle.

Gabbles can’t keep a secret to save her pot. She says it’s not gossip, it’s emotional circulation. She feels everything and everyone, like a satellite tuned to the family’s collective nervous system, then retells it all with a little extra flair (and a few incorrect details). It’s her way of trying to make sense of what’s happening around her, it’s not gossip, it’s processing. She swears it’s out of love, and honestly, it is. Her chatter keeps the Dirtles stitched together, even if it drives Stubbs to groan and Gush to leak. She’s the monster who’ll comfort you, quote you, and accidentally broadcast your breakdown by dessert, all with tears in her eyes and dirt under her nails.

### Gribble Dirtle "The Earnest Meddler"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Gabbles Dirtle.

Gribble is the family’s golden retriever of mischief, bright-eyed, helpful, and absolutely terrible at minding her own business. The second child of Gabbles, she inherited her urge to connect and Peepers’ curiosity, which is to say: trouble. Gribble is the one who “accidentally” forwards the group message, blurts out surprises too early, and then tries to fix it with snacks and apologies. The Dirtles keep her around because, somehow, her disasters always end up bringing everyone closer. Underneath the mud and manic grin, Gribble’s just trying to make sure no one ever feels left out, even if it means oversharing for the greater good.

### Grimbly Dirtle "The Brace"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Peepers Dirtle.

Grimbly is always bracing for impact. Teeth clenched, shoulders up, ready for the bad news before anyone opens their mouth. Most days the bad news never comes, and he stays braced anyway, just in case. It is tiring to be ready all the time. He would know. Grimbly is not grumpy, whatever his face says. He is just very, very prepared. The family keeps telling him he can relax. He keeps saying he will, right after this.

### Huddle Dirtle "The Self-Hug"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Brindle Dirtle.

Huddle wraps his arms around himself because somebody has to. He is small and dark and keeps to himself, holding on tight like the world might tip over. He learned early that comfort was a do-it-yourself project. He is very good at it now. Too good. Offer him a hug and he will thank you and keep his arms exactly where they are. Huddle is not cold. He is warm all the way through. He is just still learning that he is allowed to let go.

### Marnie Dirtle "The Tender Overthinker"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Craig Dirtle.

Marnie grew up learning that love could change its tone mid-sentence. Daughter of Craig, the Dirtle you want to trust but probably shouldn’t, she learned early to listen for the quiet shifts under people’s words. Now she feels everything twice: once for herself and once for whoever’s nearby. Marnie tries to make everyone comfortable, even when it knots her stomach; she smooths tension like it’s her job. She over-explains, over-apologizes, and then beats herself up for doing both. But here’s the thing, Marnie’s softness isn’t weakness; it’s survival that turned gentle. She’s chaos-resilient, heartbreak-fluent, and somehow still believes people mean well.

### Murk Dirtle "The Night Shift"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Fennick Dirtle.

Murk does his best work at three in the morning. Not good work, exactly. Thinking. He replays the day, plans for disasters that will not happen, and remembers something embarrassing from 2011 in perfect detail. His eyes are wide open because they always are. During the day he is quiet and a little foggy, sipping something warm and saying he is just tired. He is. Murk keeps watch so the rest of the house can sleep. Nobody ever asked him to, and nobody has told him he can stop.

### Ollie Dirtle "The Don’t Shoot"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Gribble Dirtle.

Ollie has his hands up before anyone has raised their voice. He surrenders early and often, agrees with whoever spoke last, and has never once won an argument because he has never once started one. Peace at any price, and he is usually the one paying. He is gentle, funny and very good at reading a room, mostly so he can leave it. Somewhere in there is an opinion. It has been waiting a long time for the room to feel safe enough to come out.

### Orbin Dirtle "The Detached Charmer"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Craig Dirtle.

Orbin learned early that in the Dirtle family, the loudest feelings get the least attention. So he made detachment an art form. Where his sister Marnie spirals, Orbin shrugs; where others overshare, he cracks a joke and changes the subject. Raised by Craig, who called every broken promise “a learning experience,” Orbin built his personality around staying one emotional step removed. He’s funny, magnetic, and everyone thinks he’s fine… but that’s kind of the point. Underneath the calm exterior, he’s constantly managing how much of himself to show. Still, there’s something comforting about him, like he’s been through every storm already and decided to just hand you an umbrella instead of making it a big deal.

### Peepers Dirtle "The Relentless Observer"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Gabbles Dirtle.

Peepers doesn’t just see everything, he collects it, like gossip is his inheritance. The son of Gabbles, he turned her habit of “processing out loud” into a full-blown art form. Every look, every slip-up, every side comment, it all goes into Peepers’ personal museum of family moments, ready to bring it back up at the worst possible time. Loud, stained, and proud of it, he swears he’s just “keeping the record straight,” but everyone knows he edits the story for drama. His wandering eye (literally) means the Dirtles never quite know when they’re being watched, or worse, remembered.

### Siddles Dirtle "The Calm Before Everyone Else"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. First generation.

Siddles is the original root, the one who showed up first and somehow set the tone for everything that followed. He doesn’t need to brag, every monster swears they carry a piece of him anyway: Gribble’s manic spark, Gabbles’ endless stories, Gush’s tidal wave of feelings. Siddles doesn’t demand or scold, but his presence alone radiates a quiet “make me proud” that gets under everyone’s skin. He’s the archetype of steady gravity, the one you measure yourself against whether you want to or not. Loving, patient, but impossible to fool, Siddles is proof that even chaos has a backbone.

### Stubbs Dirtle "The Blunt Caretaker"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Adopted. Parent: Siddles Dirtle.

Stubbs is built like a brick and twice as stubborn. He talks shit like it’s a love language, heckling everyone in reach, especially Gush, who he swears could turn into a puddle if you looked at him too hard. He swears he’s the foundation of the family, and honestly? He’s not wrong. Stubbs doesn’t do vulnerability; he does commentary. But beneath all that noise is someone who keeps everyone steady just by showing up. Siddles calls him his “favorite accident,” and the rest of the Rootkins know the truth: without Stubbs, the whole thing might actually fall apart.

### Tobbin Dirtle "The Second Guess"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Marnie Dirtle.

Tobbin made a decision once. He has been revisiting it ever since. He reads the reviews after he buys it, rewrites the text after he sends it, and lies awake wondering if the waiter was being sarcastic. His big front teeth stick out a little, like the rest of him is leaning forward to check. He means well. He just cannot shake the feeling that the right answer was the other one. The family says he is careful. Tobbin says he is fine. Then he checks.

### Wendel Dirtle "The Polite Grin"

Family: Dirtle. Status: Available. Parent: Orbin Dirtle.

Wendel smiles through everything. Bad news, good news, a long wait at the post office, it all gets the same wide, careful grin. He learned early that a pleasant face keeps rooms calm, and he has been keeping rooms calm ever since. Nobody has ever seen him upset, which he counts as a win and which is also the problem. Underneath the grin is a whole weather system he files away for later. Later has not come yet. He is lovely company. He would like, just once, to be asked how he actually is.

### Candor Glimmerwick "The Host"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Dax Glimmerwick.

Candor holds a candle in every hand and a smile for every guest. She is the host, always, even at other people’s houses. Drinks topped up, introductions made, awkward silences filled with a story about her cousin. Everyone has a wonderful time. Candor has a wonderful time making sure everyone has a wonderful time, which is not quite the same thing. When the last guest leaves she blows out the candles one by one and sits in the dark for a while, enjoying the quiet she never asks for.

### Dax Glimmerwick "The Overthinker with Great Timing"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Janice Glimmerwick.

Dax is a Glimmerwick with a mic and a moral compass that keeps recalibrating. Born with one foot in wisdom and the other in a mouth he can’t seem to close, he’s the monster who’ll make a full confession just to prove he’s self-aware. It’s oddly endearing, like watching someone trip on enlightenment. He’s got Janice’s soul-deep empathy but uses it for debates, self-reflection, and unsolicited advice. Every mistake becomes a “lesson,” every lesson becomes content, and somehow it all lands because, annoyingly, he means it. When the family’s losing it, Dax plays mediator-slash-mess. He’ll analyze your trauma with startling precision, then immediately step in it himself. Still, everyone loves having him around, he’s proof that even the most chaotic monster can grow… provided he’s narrating it in real time.

### Delphine Glimmerwick "The Blush"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Gush Glimmerwick.

Delphine feels everything on her face first. A compliment, a crush, a slightly too long pause, and there it is, the little red swirl on her cheek, telling on her. She hates it. Everyone else finds it the most honest thing about her. She would love to be mysterious. She is the opposite of mysterious. The Glimmerwicks have tried teaching her a poker face for years, and she cries a little every time they say how proud they are of her.

### Fratch Glimmerwick "The Performing Storm"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Gush Glimmerwick.

Fratch doesn’t process emotions, he performs them. Everything’s a bit, a story, a song that accidentally turns into a confession. He talks fast, laughs loud, and fills every silence like it’s an emergency. He calls it energy; Gush calls it avoidance. Still, there’s something magnetic about the way he keeps it all in motion, a blur of jokes, feelings, and half-finished projects, as if stopping might make everything hit at once. He’s chaos with a pulse, and somehow, it’s impossible not to love him for it.

### Gumphrey Glimmerwick "The Beautiful Detour"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Adopted. Parent: Pigpen Glimmerwick.

Gumphrey does not need things to make perfect sense to get involved. In fact, he prefers a little confusion. He moves through life like the details will sort themselves out eventually, and honestly, they usually do. He was formed somewhere between curiosity and a refusal to overthink it, which is why he tends to say yes before fully understanding what he is agreeing to. It is not that he lacks awareness. It is that he does not believe everything needs to be solved before it can be enjoyed. The truth is, Gumphrey trusts that something good is happening, even if it is a little chaotic getting there. And more often than not, he ends up being right.

### Gush Glimmerwick "The Overwhelmed Empath"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Janice Glimmerwick.

Gush has no chill, none. He’s the type that soaks up everyone else’s tension like a sponge and then leaks it out in nervous sweat, sighs, or way-too-honest overshares. Gush is the monster equivalent of a “cry in the bathroom stall, then come back making jokes” archetype: deeply feeling, a little dramatic, and somehow still endearing. He’s the friend who insists he can carry your baggage… and then immediately trips over it, apologizing while still holding on. It’s exhausting, but it’s also what makes him magnetic: he cares even when he shouldn’t.

### Hortencia Glimmerwick "The Show Before the Storm"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Adopted. Parent: Janice Glimmerwick.

Hortencia is living theater, always mid-gasp like the world’s about to end because someone finished the snacks. She thrives on spectacle, if there isn’t chaos, she’ll create it, complete with dramatic exits and teary toasts. She’s the archetype of “Romantic Chaos”: magnetic, glamorous, impossible to ignore, and exhausting in the best way. Janice calls her a masterpiece of performance; Ziggo just calls her a headache. Either way, no family gathering is complete without her latest production.

### Janice Glimmerwick "The Soft Howl"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. First generation.

Janice is the matriarch of the Glimmerwicks, the first to turn raw feeling into performance and make heartbreak look like ritual. She feels deeper, hurts louder, loves harder turning it all into her art. Every dramatic descendant of hers still carries that echo, the hunger to turn pain into something that means something. She’s a beautiful mess, all soul, no filter, and about three feelings away from a breakdown or a revelation (sometimes both). Beneath all the color and noise, though, she’s soft. The kind who pretends she doesn’t care but secretly feels everything and everyone. She’ll tell you she’s fine, even when she’s falling apart, because that’s how she was raised, to keep singing through the ache and call it living. The rest of the monsters say she feels too much, but Janice swears that’s the point: “If you’re not breaking a little, you’re not alive.”

### Lulu Glimmerwick "The Hand Up"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Fratch Glimmerwick.

Lulu always has her hand up. She has a question, an answer, a better idea, and a story that is only sort of related. She wants to be picked so badly it makes her arm tired. Being noticed feels like oxygen to her, and silence feels like a test she is failing. The Glimmerwicks call it enthusiasm. Her teachers called it a lot. The truth is that Lulu does not need the spotlight as much as she needs proof that someone is glad she is in the room. Tell her once, and the hand comes down a little.

### Ned Glimmerwick "The Gentle Panic"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Adopted. Parent: Hortencia Glimmerwick.

Ned’s the kind of monster who says he’s “fine” while clearly holding back tears and blood pressure. Raised by Hortencia, who believes volume equals healing, he learned early how to manage chaos by apologizing to it. There’s something endlessly lovable about him, though: he’s nervous, sincere, and always trying to do the right thing, even if it means overthinking himself into a coma.He feels everything at once, pride, guilt, existential dread, and it all leaks out his nose a little. The family lets him talk through it because watching him spiral is half therapy, half performance art. Still, Ned’s the glue in the mess. He’s the one who checks in after every argument, makes sure everyone’s okay, and somehow still blames himself. The others tease him for being soft, but when the dust settles, Ned’s always the one sweeping it up, shaking, smiling, and saying, “It’s okay! It’s all part of the process!”

### Nooks Glimmerwick "The Hideout"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Ned Glimmerwick.

Nooks is low to the ground and hard to find. She is happiest under a blanket, behind a door, at the back of the party near the snacks. Only her eyes peek out, bright pink, taking in everything. She is not shy so much as careful, and she has excellent taste in hiding spots. When she does come out, she is wickedly funny and remembers everything you said. Nooks does not need to be dragged into the spotlight. She just needs someone to notice when she is missing.

### Ottoline Glimmerwick "The Too Many Hands"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Candor Glimmerwick.

Ottoline has a hand for everything and everything in hand. Cooking, calling, planning, fixing, remembering birthdays, holding a candle for whoever needs the light. She grew another arm every time someone needed one, and someone always needed one. She is magnificent and a little bit on fire. The family runs on her and mostly does not notice. What Ottoline wants, though she would never say it, is one quiet afternoon with nothing in any of her hands.

### Pigpen Glimmerwick "The Dirty Charmer"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Ziggo Glimmerwick.

Pigpen is what happens when passion forgets to shower. The most down-to-earth of the Glimmerwicks, he’s got a soul that hums like an old amp and a heart that leaks honesty. He doesn’t sparkle like his dad Ziggo or howl like Grandma Janice, he just shows up, plays the blues of his own making, and lets everyone else figure out what it means. He’s got a knack for making chaos look casual, the kind of monster who’ll give life advice that sounds like nonsense until six months later when you realize he was right. Quietly magnetic, surprisingly loyal, and never fully clean, Pigpen believes in two things: good company and better messes.

### Smudge Glimmerwick "The Leftover Feeling"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Hortencia Glimmerwick.

Smudge shows up after. After the party, after the fight, after everyone else has gone home and the dishes are still in the sink. He is made of whatever did not get said, drips and stains and a face that looks like it is trying to remember something. He is small and easy to ignore, which is how he got so full. Smudge does not want much. He would just like someone to sit with him for a minute before the lights go off.

### Swish Glimmerwick "The Exit Strategy"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Ziggo Glimmerwick.

Swish always knows where the door is. Her tail is half out of the room before the conversation gets serious. She is charming, fast and impossible to pin down, and she leaves every party with an Irish goodbye and a great story. Commitment makes her itchy. Being needed makes her itchier. The Glimmerwicks say she was born mid-exit. Swish says she just likes options. One day she will stay through the hard part, and she will be surprised how much she likes it.

### Tessik Glimmerwick "This Way or That"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Ned Glimmerwick.

Tessik sees more than one version of things at the same time, which makes moving forward both easier and harder than it should be. One eye tracks what is, the other what could be, and neither fully lets go. He lives in that space where two truths exist without canceling each other out, which is why he rarely feels certain but almost always feels aware. It is not that he cannot decide. It is that he understands what each path holds before taking it. Tessik does not need everything to resolve into one clean answer. He just carries both, and moves anyway.

### Violetta Glimmerwick "The Reach"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Pigpen Glimmerwick.

Violetta is always reaching. For the next thing, the better thing, the thing on the top shelf. Arms up, mouth open, already halfway out of the bowl. She is glamorous and hungry and absolutely sure the good part is just past where she is now. She has had a lot of good parts. She did not stay for most of them. The Glimmerwicks admire her ambition and worry about her a little. What Violetta has not tried yet is putting her arms down and seeing what is already in reach.

### Ziggo Glimmerwick "The Shapeshift Kid"

Family: Glimmerwick. Status: Available. Parent: Janice Glimmerwick.

Ziggo was born mid-transformation and just… never stopped. He’s got his mother Janice’s soul, but instead of crying about it, he paints it gold and sells tickets. Every day’s a new phase, a new persona, a new attempt at sincerity that somehow still ends up looking like art. He’s charming, weird, and exhausting in equal measure, the kind of monster who calls his breakdowns “creative direction” and means it. Beneath the showmanship, though, there’s a quiet kind of ache, the awareness that if you’re always becoming something new, you never really get to be. Still, Ziggo doesn’t mind. He says identity’s just another costume, and the trick is to wear it until it fits. The rest of the Glimmerwicks think he’s a genius or a lunatic (depending on the lighting), but everyone agrees on one thing: wherever Ziggo goes, reality bends a little to make room.

### Bellowan Roarborn "The Echo Chamber"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Available. Parent: Druthal Roarborn.

Bellowan doesn’t speak, he projects. Every sentence sounds like a public announcement, even if he’s just saying “good morning.” Subtlety? Never met her. Born from Druthal’s fiery line, he turned “roar” into a personality trait and hasn’t used an indoor voice since. He’s the kind of monster who thinks volume equals vulnerability, if he’s yelling, it must be heartfelt. He’s all passion, no pause button, and when he gets emotional (which is hourly), it’s everyone’s problem. Still, you can’t help but love him. He cheers too loud, laughs too hard, and somehow makes every room feel like a standing ovation. Bellowan’s chaos is exhausting, but it’s also kind of inspiring, proof that being too much is sometimes exactly enough.

### Bramble Roarborn "The Thorn"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Available. Parent: Spatter Roarborn.

Bramble is all points. Touch him wrong and you will know about it. He grew those spikes after one bad winter and never saw a reason to put them away. He grins a lot, which confuses people, because the grin is real. Bramble loves his family fiercely and defends them louder than anyone. He just does it from behind a wall of prickles. The ones who get close say he is the softest monster in the house. They have the scratches to prove they got close.

### Cinder Roarborn "The Overheated Caregiver"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Available. Parent: Druthal Roarborn.

Cinder’s been “fine” for about three seconds in her entire life. She feels everything, too much, too loud, too soon, and somehow drags everyone else into it like it’s a group project. When she’s happy, she glows; when she’s angry, she radiates. The family stopped letting her near candles after The Incident (which she swears was “mostly experimental”). She inherited Druthal’s spark but none of his filter, and her idea of conflict resolution is usually to shout “I love you, but you’re wrong!” Still, she’s the first to show up when someone’s hurting, crying, defending, or both at once. Cinder doesn’t just bring the heat, she is the heat: unpredictable, loyal, and impossible to ignore.

### Clatter Roarborn "The Loud Yes"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Available. Parent: Plink Roarborn.

Clatter says yes to everything, loudly, with both arms in the air. Yes to the trip, yes to the favor, yes to the second dessert and the third. He loves being the one who is always up for it. Saying no feels to him like closing a door that might never open again. His calendar is a disaster and his heart is enormous. Every so often Clatter finds himself somewhere he never wanted to be, cheering, because he did not know how to say otherwise.

### Droozle Roarborn "The Joy Emergency"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Adopted. Parent: Sunder Roarborn.

Droozle is the eternal optimist. He’ll gush about the weather, your haircut, or the way the chips taste today, grinning like everything’s a miracle. But every so often, the smile cracks, he’ll go wide-eyed, hiss “fuck olives,” or declare some random thing the worst abomination on earth. Then, just as fast, he’s back to sunshine and giggles, leaving everyone unsettled but strangely charmed. His dad Sunder pretends he doesn’t understand where Droozle gets it, but the family knows the answer: over-feeling runs deep in their branch.

### Druthal Roarborn "The Reluctant Volcano"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Available. First generation.

Druthal is one of the ancients, he and Veyla emerged as siblings from the primordial clay, and while Siddles became the family’s quiet root, Druthal burned into its firebrand. His branch runs hot: his children are loud, reckless, and spectacular, and he wouldn’t have it any other way. His face is carved from centuries of watching fools repeat the same mistakes, every crease a record of history’s stubborn loops. He doesn’t hand out wisdom so much as mutter strange fragments that sound profound, until you realize they might just be nonsense. Still, his presence carries weight, and the fire still burns steady.

### Frizz Roarborn "The Short Fuse"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Available. Parent: Moro Roarborn.

Frizz runs hot. You can see it on him, little red lines all over, like a map of every time someone cut in line. He goes from fine to furious in the time it takes to say "calm down", which you should never say to him. He is not mean. He is just carrying a lot of pressure in a small container. After the eruption he is the first to apologize and the last to forgive himself. The Roarborns think he is perfectly normal, which explains a lot.

### Gorble Roarborn "The Big Leap"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Available. Parent: Droozle Roarborn.

Gorble does not ease into things. He arrives already involved. He meets moments like they have been waiting for him specifically, which is how he ends up caring before it is entirely reasonable. He's the kinda monster who always says yes with his whole body and figures out the details later. It is not that he does not see the risks. It is that he does not believe they are a good enough reason to stay out of it. The truth is, Gorble lives a little ahead of certainty. And while that gets him into things quickly, it also lets him experience things most creatures never quite step into.

### Grax Roarborn "The Charge Ahead"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Available. Parent: Gorble Roarborn.

Grax has horns for a reason. He goes straight at things, head down, grinning, and he gets there first more often than you would think. Doors, deadlines, arguments, a buffet: he meets them all at full speed. Slowing down feels to him like giving up. He is fiercely loyal and hard to stop, and the trail behind him is mostly broken furniture and finished projects. What Grax has never tried is standing still long enough to find out what he is running toward.

### Moro Roarborn "The Self-Aware Wildfire"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Adopted. Parent: Druthal Roarborn.

Moro swears she’s not like her father, less roar, more “intentional flame.” And yet, every time she promises to stay calm, something bursts into smoke. She’s the kind of monster who journals about patience, then yells at her reflection for not growing fast enough. Druthal says she’s his “lesson in humility,” though she suspects he means “karma.” Still, for all her dramatics, Moro burns with purpose. She’s learning, slowly, that fire isn’t just for destruction. Sometimes, it’s for light, warmth, or the occasional righteous meltdown.

### Murn Roarborn "The Hidden Flame"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Adopted. Parent: Cinder Roarborn.

Murn is all still water with dangerous undertow. Quiet, calculating, and impossible to read, he sits back while everyone else burns themselves out, only to drop one perfectly-timed remark that tilts the entire room. He doesn’t waste energy, but when he chooses to engage, it matters. People either love him for his insight or hate him for being right, but either way, they remember it. Murn is the monster archetype of hidden depth, reserved, mischievous, and sharper than you realize until it’s too late.

### Noshik Roarborn "The Backup Miracle"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Adopted. Parent: Plink Roarborn.

Noshik believes in miracles. Fully. Wholeheartedly. No notes. He just also believes it would be irresponsible not to have a backup. Arms out, already offering, already insisting, he moves through life like things will work out, but only because he made sure they could. He was formed in that space between faith and practicality, which is why he shows up early, brings extra, and somehow has exactly what is needed before anyone asks. You say it will all come together and he agrees, while quietly setting up three ways it cannot fall apart. The truth is, he loves when a miracle happens. He just prefers to be the reason it does.

### Pip Roarborn "Give It Up"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Available. Parent: Droozle Roarborn.

Pip has it written on her body in case anyone forgets: give it up. She means it the nice way. Give it up for the birthday girl, for the band, for the guy who parallel parked on the first try. She is the loudest clapper in any room and the first to start a standing ovation, whether or not one was called for. The Roarborns love having her around. The thing about Pip is that the phrase cuts both ways, and some nights she wonders if it is also advice. She has not given up on anything yet. She just likes knowing the option is there.

### Plink Roarborn "The Sparkplug"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Available. Parent: Cinder Roarborn.

Plink inherited Cinder’s fire but uses it like a sparkler at a house party, flashy, silly, and slightly dangerous if you’re not paying attention. He’s the type who starts ten things at once, forgets half of them, and still somehow pulls it off with charm. Endlessly entertaining, occasionally exhausting, Plink is the one who will make you laugh until you choke while also setting something on fire in the background. He’s the monster archetype of reckless joy, beloved, unpredictable, and impossible to ignore.

### Spatter Roarborn "The Overcorrection"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Available. Parent: Bellowan Roarborn.

Spatter swears she’s not dramatic, which is, of course, the most dramatic thing you can say. She grew up surrounded by shouting (Bellowan, mostly), so now she’s overcompensating with what she calls “emotional restraint” and everyone else calls “weird tension.” She’s trying to be chill. She really is. But her version of chill looks like bottling everything up until it bursts out sideways, usually in the form of a monologue or an accidental public meltdown. The mess isn’t on purpose… it’s just hereditary. Still, there’s something deeply lovable about Spatter’s chaos. She’s the first to clean up a disaster, usually one she caused, and the last to leave a party she swore she wasn’t attending. Being

### Spindle Roarborn "The Big Reaction"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Available. Parent: Bellowan Roarborn.

Spindle does not have small feelings. A spilled drink is a tragedy. A good sandwich is a religious experience. A text that says "k" is grounds for a family meeting. Spikes up, arms up, mouth wide open, every time. Living with him is exhausting and never boring. The thing nobody expects is how fast it passes. Spindle feels it all the way through, top to bottom, and then it is gone and he is asking what is for dinner. Some of the family could learn from that.

### Sunder Roarborn "The Argument in Progress"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Available. Parent: Druthal Roarborn.

Sunder was born mid-argument and just… never stopped. Two brains, one mouth, zero chance of peace. Every thought he has tries to come out at once, which means most of his sentences end in a frustrated growl or a dramatic sigh. He calls it “deep thinking” and no one really wants to correct him. Druthal says he inherited the family fire twice over, and it shows. He's passionate, loud, and somehow always a little singed. Still, it’s hard not to love him; he’ll debate you to the brink of madness, then hand you a snack like nothing happened. Sunder doesn’t argue to win, he argues because he can’t help it… though winning is definitely a bonus.

### Tav Roarborn

Family: Roarborn. Status: Adopted. Parent: Murn Roarborn.

Tav is not interested in keeping things comfortable. One hand stays close, steady, present, while the other makes it clear she is not here for the version of the story that sounds better than it is. She has a way of clocking what is off almost immediately, like your body told her before you did. You might try to smooth it over. You might joke. You might almost get away with it. She will let you try. She just will not let you skip it. She has a way of cutting through just enough to let something real breathe. The truth is, Tav does care. Deeply. She just knows that healing does not come from being handled gently all the time. Sometimes it starts the second you stop pretending you are fine.

### Tiv Roarborn "The Gentle Undoing"

Family: Roarborn. Status: Adopted. Parent: Murn Roarborn.

Tiv does not say much, which is how people end up saying more than they planned. He listens with a kind of patience that feels almost suspicious, like he already knows there is something underneath what you are saying and is willing to wait for it. He was formed in stillness, the kind that does not rush to fill space, which is why being around him can feel both comforting and a little exposing. You start talking just to break the silence, and then keep going because he does not interrupt. The truth is, Tiv is not trying to get anything out of you. He just stays long enough for you to hear yourself clearly. And once you do, it is hard to pretend you did not.
